spin-off from https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/1484#issuecomment-1403257737

Requirement text needs validation and language/grammar check:
Verify that decoding is done only once and as the first step e. g. decoding is not done after input validation or sanitization.

Category choice is not clearly obvious, but I think it should be part of input validation requirements as the requirement should take away potential bypass for input validation.

comments.body: The requirement should also cover "de-escaping" (how it is called?)
Add to new section described here: https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/1484#issuecomment-1933966658

I update the proposal wording:
_Verify that decoding or de-escaping is done only once and before processing the input further e. g. it is not done after input validation or sanitization._

ping  @tghosth @jmanico
Why is decoding a core requirement? It's rarely needed.

> Why is decoding a core requirement? It's rarely needed.

Jim, is it some kind of provocation or are you serious? :o

Anyway, please read discussion here: https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/1484

And visit [link](https://securityblog.omegapoint.se/en/writeup-keycloak-cve-2023-6027/) provided in this issue 4 comments earlier: https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/1590#issuecomment-1889338193

I agree encoding is important all over the place to stop injection.

I rarely use decoding as a developer for security purposes. My only point, no provocation intended.

> I agree encoding is important all over the place to stop injection. I rarely use decoding as a developer for security purposes. My only point, no provocation intended.

"I don't use" here means probably "I don't implement manually, because the framework does it for me". But it must be done and it must be done in correct order.

> Verify that input is decoded or unescaped into a canonical form only once and that this is done before processing the input further, for example it is not performed after input validation or sanitization.

Updated wording discussed between @elarlang and @tghosth
Ok I think we are good with this one

Added requirement:
| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **5.6.1** | [ADDED] Verify that input is decoded or unescaped into a canonical form only once and that this is done before processing the input further, for example it is not performed after input validation or sanitization. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | 174 |

I think we need to address one more case to be more clear: decoding must be used only for encoded data.

Problem to solve: when there is for example URL-decoding in place when it should not be used, as described in the "path traversal" section.
https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/1589#issuecomment-2103948623

How about:

| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **5.6.1** | [ADDED] Verify that input is decoded or unescaped into a canonical form only once, **it is only decoded when encoded data in that form is expected,** and that this is done before processing the input further, for example it is not performed after input validation or sanitization. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | 174 |

@elarlang
@elarlang please approve #2017 or let me know if it needs changes,
